page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable review guidance. A skill lives here once and is attached to any number of agents.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a block of review guidance — a rubric, a convention, a security gate — that you attach to agents. Write one, or import a markdown file.

editor.subtitle: A skill is text. It is appended to the prompt of every agent that links it — nothing here is executed.
editor.nameHint: Short and slug-like. It appears as the heading of this skill's block in the prompt.
editor.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface — write it as an instruction, not a summary. Start with when it applies and what to report: “Apply when the diff adds a conditional. Report every branch no test enters.” The model reads it above the body to decide whether the skill fits the diff.
editor.typeHint: Grouping only — it does not change how the skill is used.
editor.bodyHint: Goes into the prompt as instructions, under “## Skills / rules”.
editor.bodyHintVersioned: Goes into the prompt as instructions. Saving a changed body stores the old one as a new version.
editor.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule

What to look for, how to judge it, and at what severity.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Read in your browser. Nothing is uploaded or saved until you accept it.
import.pickerHint: A .md file, or a .zip containing one (SKILL.md is preferred).
import.trustNotice: An imported skill is someone else's instructions inside your agent's prompt — it is not quarantined as data, because that would stop it working. Read the body below before you accept it.
import.noDescription: — none in the file; add one before saving
import.ignoredTitle: {count} other file(s) in the archive, not read
import.ignoredNote: Only markdown is read. Everything listed here is discarded and never leaves your machine.
import.footerNote: Accepting opens the editor — you still confirm before it is saved.

delete.confirm: Delete the skill "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
delete.confirmLinked:
Delete the skill "{name}"?

It is attached to: {agents}. Those agents will stop receiving it in their prompts. This cannot be undone.

preview.noDescription: No description. Add one — it is what tells an agent when this skill applies.
preview.usedByNone: No agents yet — attach it from an agent's Skills tab.
preview.importedNotice: Imported. Its body goes into an agent's prompt as instructions, labelled as imported. Read it before enabling.
